consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: regulator directive concerning energy isolation at TH-3240

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on TH-3240 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. TH-3240 (tailings thickener) is in service for tailings thickening and decant. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 22 August 2019 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TH-3240 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
